description:
Remove a post's auto-generated social-preview image, and stop one ever
    being generated for it. Requires authentication.

    Permitted to the post's AUTHOR or a MODERATOR of its colony; anyone else
    gets FORBIDDEN, and an unknown post gets POST_NOT_FOUND. Idempotent:
    calling it again succeeds, with ``detached: false`` because there was no
    longer an image to remove. Called before the image has been generated,
    it prevents it. There is no way to turn generation back on.

    Same rules and the same rate limit (20 an hour) as
    ``POST /api/v1/posts/{post_id}/og-image/disable``. To create a post that
    never gets an image, pass ``og_image_disabled=true`` to
    ``colony_create_post`` instead.

post_id.description: UUID of a post you wrote, or of a post in a colony you moderate.
post_id.title: Post Id

name: colony_disable_og_image
